content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Add to Calendar Feature ## slug: attendeelink-add-calendar ## seoTitle: Add to Calendar Feature ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Help your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s remember everything they need to know about their upcoming {{variable.Object_Event}} with the {{variable.AttendeeLink}}s Add to Calendar feature. It’s as simple as clicking the {{variable.Button_AddtoCalendar}} button and selecting a calendar platform. ![AddToCalendar_Registered](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_Registered.png){height="" width=""} ## Change the Calendar Invite Message To customize the invite message and location that your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s see in their calendar app, complete the following steps. 1. Confirm that the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarLocation}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} fields are on your {{variable.Object_Event}} record page layout. ![AddToCalendar_EventRecord](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_EventRecord.png){height="" width=""} 3. If the fields are already on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record page layout, go to Step 9. 4. If they aren’t, click the **Gear** icon in the top right corner. 5. Click **Edit Object**. 6. Search for and click the {{variable.Object_Event}} object. 7. Click **Page Layout**. 9. Add the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarLocation}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} fields to the page layout. ![AddToCalendar_EventPageLayout](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_EventPageLayout.png){height="" width=""} 12. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. Go to your event’s {{variable.Object_Event}} record and confirm the fields are visible. ![AddToCalendar_EventRecord](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_EventRecord.png){height="" width=""} 14. Enter a new {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarLocation}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}}. 15. Check the {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomURLCalendDescr}} checkbox if you want {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to see Zoom URLs in the invite’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} field after they click the **Add to Calendar** button. 16. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![AddToCalendar_FieldsComplete](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_FieldsComplete.png){height="" width=""} 17. Click **Update** to update the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ## The Attendee Experience ![AddToCalendar_ViewEvent](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_ViewEvent.png){height="" width=""} After completing the registration process, {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will receive a success message with the {{variable.Button_AddtoCalendar}} button. ![AddToCalendar_Registered](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_Registered.png){height="" width=""} Clicking the {{variable.Button_AddtoCalendar}} button will open a picklist where the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s can choose their preferred calendar platform. ![AddToCalendar_ClickAddToCalendar](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_ClickAddToCalendar.png){height="" width=""} The newly created calendar invite will include all of the relevant {{variable.Object_Event}} information EXCEPT the venue information and description. Instead, the information in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarLocation}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} fields will be shown. ![AddToCalendar_ViewInfoCalendarInvite](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddToCalendar_ViewInfoCalendarInvite.png){height="" width=""}
